ns2:section.sectionText: Be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount for this variable credit course (2 or 4 hours). The registration system will input 2 hours by default so if you want to enroll for 4 hours you will need to change it. LIS 404AG is open to LIS graduate students; other graduate students need permission of instructor (cjenkin@illinois.edu). Meets with undergraduate (junior or senior) section LIS 404AU.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
